original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚奥约州油罐车与四辆商用车相撞致五人死亡
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚奥约州阿基涅莱地方政府区发生一起交通事故，一辆满载4.5万升柴油的油罐车因刹车失灵，撞压多辆车辆。事故造成五人当场死亡，死者为两男三女。事故涉及油罐车、一辆无牌照汽车和四辆被称为Micra的商用车。目前信息来自单一来源报道。

location.site: Aduloju, along the Ojoo–Iwo Road expressway, Akinyele LGA
location.raw_text: Aduloju, along the Ojoo–Iwo Road expressway, in Akinyele Local Government Area of Oyo State

key_facts.fact: 一辆满载4.5万升柴油的油罐车在奥约州阿基涅莱地方政府区撞压车辆
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Five persons have been killed after a fully loaded 45,000-litre diesel tanker crushed vehicles at Aduloju, along the Ojoo–Iwo Road expressway, in Akinyele Local Government Area of Oyo State, on Saturday.

key_facts.fact: 事故造成五人死亡，为两男三女，据报当场死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The victims, comprising two males and three females, reportedly died on the spot.

key_facts.fact: 事故涉及油罐车、一辆无牌照汽车和四辆商用车
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The accident involved the tanker, an unregistered car and four commercial vehicles popularly known as Micra cars.

key_facts.fact: 油罐车因刹车失灵引发事故
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Five people have been killed after a diesel tanker suffered a brake failure and crushed four commercial vehicles in Akinyele LGA of Oyo State.

uncertainties: 伤亡人数与事故细节目前仅来自单一来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
目击者陈述未经独立核实
